title: Refactor(runtime): isolate per-SKU defaults into sku_defaults module + unit tests to reduce drift
author: Ethan Park
description: Motivation: As we iterate on the hardware tuning profiles pack, we’ve ended up with per-SKU “defaults” being duplicated across (a) profile pack examples, (b) runtime selection codepaths, and (c) a couple of tests. This has already caused drift in the L40S concurrency cap and KV headroom defaults during recent rebases. This PR centralizes the canonical per-SKU defaults in a dedicated module and adds unit tests that enforce: (1) required knobs exist for each supported SKU, (2) SKU defaults stay within safety guardrails, and (3) selection code uses the same defaults surface as profile config generation. What changed: - Introduced runtime/profiles/sku_defaults (single source of truth for per-SKU baseline defaults: H100, L40S, and B200-preview placeholder) - Updated profile selection to reference sku_defaults instead of embedding constants in selector.rs - Added unit tests covering required fields, invariant checks (e.g., max_concurrency bounds, min_kv_headroom_mb), and a snapshot test of the resolved defaults for each SKU - Added a small helper to render defaults into debug output (so /health + startup log remain stable after moving constants) Notes / non-goals: This PR does not change actual knob values (intended to be a refactor-only change). Any behavioral changes should be treated as bugs; the new tests are intended to make that obvious. Follow-ups: Once this lands, we should (separately) update the in-repo docs examples to import from the same source (ENG-4932 tracking docs alignment).
commits: runtime/profiles: add sku_defaults module + typed defaults struct
runtime/profiles: refactor selector to use sku_defaults and remove duplicated constants
runtime/tests: add sku defaults invariant tests + golden snapshots
runtime/logging: keep startup summary stable after refactor
conversation: Noah Patel: Thanks for doing this — we’ve had too many “where did this default come from?” moments. Two questions: (1) can we ensure the module can’t be bypassed (i.e., no one reintroduces constants in selector.rs)? (2) does this introduce any init-order/circular deps with runtime_config? Ethan Park (author): (1) I removed all literal per-SKU constants from selector.rs and added a unit test that fails if selector resolves defaults without going through sku_defaults::for_sku(). That should catch regressions. (2) No new circular deps: sku_defaults depends only on typed knob structs + SKU enum; runtime_config depends on sku_defaults for rendering debug summaries, but selector/runtime_config already shared those structs. Sofia Ivanova: Can we add an invariant that queue_limit_ms is <= admission_control_window_ms for each SKU? We had one bad config in the draft. Ethan Park (author): Good call. Added to sku_defaults_invariants_test.rs and fixed the one mismatch in the L40S defaults (it was already corrected elsewhere, this just brings the refactor source in sync). Omar El-Sayed: Please make sure the KV headroom guardrail test doesn’t lock us into the exact MB value; we’ll likely adjust per model family. Prefer asserting min bounds + no negatives vs exact equality. Ethan Park (author): Updated: snapshot test covers the full resolved struct (so drift is visible), but invariants only assert bounds. Snapshot test can be intentionally updated when we change defaults; invariants should stay stable. Irene Choi: For B200, can we avoid claiming “supported” in code? We’re still dealing with driver/CUDA variance and want the hard compatibility gate to be explicit. Ethan Park (author): Renamed the entry to B200Preview and ensured selector refuses to use it unless profile_version is explicitly pinned (no auto-defaulting). This matches the gate in PR-24927; here we’re just centralizing the placeholder defaults. Sahana Iyer: CI: the new snapshot tests are great but please make sure they run on release/* branches too. We’ve had tests accidentally scoped to main-only pipelines. Ethan Park (author): Updated buildkite step to include runtime/tests/** and testdata/**; confirmed it triggers on release branches as well. Re-ran CI. Noah Patel: LGTM. This will make future profile pack diffs much easier to reason about. Approving. Sofia Ivanova: Approved once the queue invariant lands. (after update) Approved. Omar El-Sayed: Approved. Sahana Iyer: Approved.
release_notes: Internal: Refactor only. Canonical per-SKU runtime defaults now live in runtime/profiles/sku_defaults with unit tests to prevent drift. No intended behavior change.
